chunks: Ahmad ibn Idrees al-Qummi and Muhammad ibn Yahya narrated to me, from al-Hasan ibn Ali al-Kufi, from Musa ibn Sa'dan, from Abdullah ibn Ayyub, from Abu Yahya al-San'ani, from Abu Abdullah عليه السلام, who said:
He said to me, "O Abu Yahya, indeed for us, on the nights of Friday, there is a matter of great significance." He said: I said, "May I be sacrificed for you, and what is that matter?"

He said, "Permission is given to the souls of the deceased Prophets عليهم السلام, and the souls of the deceased successors, and the soul of the successor who is present among you, that it is ascended to the heaven until it reaches the Throne of its Lord. Then it circumambulates it seven times and performs salat (prayer) of two rak'ahs at each pillar from the pillars of the Throne. Then it is returned to the bodies in which it had been."

So the Prophets and the successors come into the morning filled with joy, and the successor who is present among you comes into the morning having been increased in his knowledge by an immense abundance.

key_terms.أَرْوَاحِ: souls or spirits, referring to the souls of the Prophets and successors
key_terms.الْأَوْصِيَاءِ: the successors, referring to the divinely appointed successors after the Prophets
key_terms.الْوَصِيِّ: the successor, specifically the living divinely appointed authority among the people
key_terms.تَطُوفَ: to circumambulate, here referring to circling the Throne
key_terms.رَكْعَتَيْنِ: two units of salat (prayer), performed at each pillar of the Throne
key_terms.عَرْشَ: the Throne, denoting the exalted divine realm approached by their souls
key_terms.عِلْمِهِ: his knowledge, which is increased abundantly
key_terms.لَيَالِي الْجُمُعَةِ: the nights of Friday, presented here as a time of special divine affair

ai.seo_question: How does this hadith describe the increase of the Imam's knowledge on Friday nights?
ai.summary: This hadith describes a special affair for the Prophets and Awsiya' on the nights of Friday, in which their souls are granted ascent to the heaven and proximity to the Divine Throne. It emphasizes the exalted station of the Awsiya' and indicates that the living Wasi is increased in knowledge through this divinely granted reality.

en.hubeali:
Ahmad Bin Idrees Al Qummy and Muhammad Bin Yahya narrated to me, from Al Hassan Bin Al Al Kufy, from Musa Bin Sa’dan, from Abdullah Bin Ayoub, from Abu Yahya Al Sana’any, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup>

having said to me: ‘O Abu Yahya! For us<sup>asws</sup> during the nights of Friday is a special issue from the issues (to be dealt with)’. I said, ‘May I be sacrificed for you<sup>asws</sup>! And what is that special issue?’

Heasws said: ‘It is Permitted for the soul of the deceased Prophetsas and the souls of the deceased successorsas, and soul of the successorasws who is apparent between you, that theyas are ascended to the sky until they perform Tawaf of the Throne of theiras Lordazwj. So they perform Tawaf of seven circuits of it and pray Salat of two cycles during every pillar from the pillars of the Throne. Then they are returned to theiras respective bodies which theyas used to be in.

So the Prophets<sup>as</sup> and the succesors<sup>as</sup> become filled with joy, and the successor<sup>asws</sup> who is apparent between you all become such that he<sup>asws</sup> is increased in his<sup>asws</sup> knowledge similar to abundant swarms (immensely)’.
en.sarwar: 1. Ahmad ibn Idris al-Qummi and Muhammad ibn Yahya have narrated from al-Hassan ibn Ali al-Kufi from Musa ibn Sa‘dan from ‘Abdallah ibn Ayyub from abu Yahya al-San‘ani from abu ‘Abdallah (a.s.) who has said the following.

“O abu Yahya, on every Friday night there is a special task for us to pursue.” The narrator has said that he asked the Imams (a.s.), ““May Allah take my soul in service for your cause, of what nature is this special task?”

The Imam (a.s.) said, “The spirits of the deceased prophets and the spirits of the deceased executors of the will of the prophets and the spirit of the executor of the will of the Holy Prophet living with you now are all taken to heavens until they arrive to the throne of their Lord and then walk around it seven times. They perform prayers near every column of the columns of the throne, in a two Rak‘at form after which they are returned to their bodies in which they were before.
The prophets and the executors of the will of the prophets become full of joy and the executor of the will of the Holy Prophet living with you receives a huge increase I n his knowledge.”
